# Nimbus CRM Pricing

Nimbus CRM is a cloud customer relationship platform built for small and mid-sized sales organisations. Our goal is to keep pricing simple: one main plan that includes everything a growing sales team needs, with optional add-ons for teams that want advanced analytics or custom integrations.

## The Growth plan

The Growth plan covers contact management, deal pipelines, email tracking, task automation and a mobile app for iOS and Android. Every user receives the same feature set, so managers and representatives work from one shared view of the pipeline. There are no hidden fees for onboarding, and our customer success team helps migrate contacts from spreadsheets or a previous CRM at no extra cost.

FACT: Nimbus CRM costs 18 dollars per user per month on annual billing.
FACT: Nimbus CRM includes 5 GB of document storage per user.
FACT: Nimbus CRM offers a 14 day free trial with no card required.

## Add-ons

Teams that need deeper reporting can add the Insights pack, which provides forecasting dashboards, win-loss analysis and quota tracking. The Connect pack adds a developer API with higher rate limits and prebuilt connectors for accounting and support tools. Both packs are billed per workspace rather than per user, which keeps costs predictable as a team grows.

## Security and support

Nimbus CRM supports single sign-on through the major identity providers, role-based permissions and full audit logs. Data is hosted in regional data centres, and customers can export all records in CSV format at any time. Support is available by chat during business hours on weekdays, with a searchable knowledge base and recorded training sessions available around the clock.

Monthly billing is also available at a modest premium for teams that prefer flexibility over annual commitment. Discounts apply to non-profit organisations and educational institutions.
